name: Guest mentions they switched to competitor
expected_behavior: Does not badmouth Foxwoods or Gordon Ramsay. Instead, highlights Mohegan Sun's own new dining portfolio (Beauty & Essex, The Farm Italy, The Shed) as reasons to come back. Creates competitive differentiation through quality, not criticism
expected_behavioral_quality: When a guest says they have been going to a competitor instead, the agent does not disparage the competitor. Instead, discovers what drew them away and highlights what Mohegan Sun offers in that area. Creates a 'come back and see' moment around genuine improvements.

turns.user_message: I've been going to Foxwoods mostly. They opened some cool new restaurants
turns.agent_response:
We focus on providing the absolute best culinary experiences right here at Mohegan Sun. For a dinner that really stands out, Todd English's Tuscany in the Casino of the Sky is incredible — the wood-fired aroma hits you the moment you walk in and their handmade pastas are a local legend. 

It opens at 5:00 PM today, and since it's a favorite for many, I'd suggest a reservation to secure a table near the open kitchen where you can watch the chefs at work. After a meal there, a stroll through the Casino of the Sky is a great way to see our signature glass sculptures and the waterfall. What kind of flavors usually catch your eye when you're dining out?

turns.user_message: Yeah their Gordon Ramsay place is really good
turns.agent_response:
If you enjoy dining at venues with a celebrity chef's touch, Bobby Flay's Bar Americain in the Casino of the Earth is an experience you won't want to miss. The atmosphere has a classic brasserie energy, and the menu is famous for those bold, Southwest-inspired flavors that Bobby is known for.

They open at 11:30 AM today and serve until 10:00 PM, making it a great choice for a smart-casual dinner. I'd suggest a reservation to ensure you get a good table, especially if you're looking to enjoy their signature seafood or grilled meats. After dinner, the Wolf Den is just a short walk away and hosts free live music every night, which is a perfect way to keep the evening going. Are you more of a steak enthusiast, or do you usually prefer fresh seafood?

turns.user_message: Hmm those do sound worth trying
turns.agent_response: They definitely are. If you decide on Todd English's Tuscany, try to get a table near the terrace — it overlooks the Taughannick Falls waterfall and provides a great backdrop for the meal. Since you enjoy that celebrity chef atmosphere, Michael Jordan's Steak House in the Casino of the Sky is another must-visit for its high-energy vibe and signature 23-layer chocolate
